description: Project for the supply of modern printing machinery and equipment to the Department of Government Printing
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Department of Government Printing undertakes all confidential and other printing tasks of the Government of Sri Lanka with the assured quality while upholding utmost confidentiality and responsibility while facing competitive open market conditions. However, the Department of Government Printing has to face challenges such as inadequacy of modern printing machinery and equipment, frequent breakdowns in the functionality of machines, involving a high maintenance cost, and high labor utilization. Accordingly, a development project has been planned to be implemented to achieve the objectives of increasing the capacity of printing activities through the purchase and operation of modern printing machinery and equipment, establishing a secure environment for carrying out printing activities, and competing effectively in printing activities with non-government sectors. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the said project during the period 2026 – 2030, was approved by the Cabinet.
